items.title: Earthquake is devastating blow to Venezuela at time of uncertainty
items.description: The twin quakes come less than six months after Venezuela's then-leader Nicolás Maduro was seized by US forces.

items.title: Aerial footage reveals destruction in coastal Venezuela
items.description: Multi-storey buildings have collapsed in La Guaira following two major earthquakes on Wednesday.

items.title: UN pauses Strait of Hormuz evacuation plan after cargo ship attacked
items.description: The ship was reportedly struck by an "unknown projectile" near Oman but no casualties were reported.

items.title: Christmas market attacker jailed for life for murdering six in Germany
items.description: A nine-year-old and five women were killed when Taleb Al-Abdulmohsen drove into the market in 2024.

items.title: Senior Ukrainian intelligence official jailed for life for spying for Russia
items.description: Col Dmytro Kozyura agreed to share state secrets and systematically disclosed classified information, prosecutors say.

items.title: Reflecting Pool liner cut with sharp knife or razor, National Park Service says
items.description: Earlier in the week Donald Trump blamed vandals for "a 300 foot long gash" in the pool and accused someone of putting fertiliser in the water.

items.title: Asia stock markets slide as tech shares slump
items.description: Trading on South Korea's Kospi index was halted for the third time this week to prevent panic selling.
